statutory_rules.title: Fair Administrative Action & Deactivation Due Process
statutory_rules.summary: Transport Network Companies must provide clear written notice, detailed grounds, and a fair opportunity for the driver to present evidence before account deactivation or suspension.

statutory_rules.title: Driver Safety Duties & Customer Conduct
statutory_rules.summary: Establishes standard safety obligations for drivers and protects drivers against baseless passenger claims when passenger misconduct occurs.

statutory_rules.title: PSV Licensing and Vehicle Compliance Standards
statutory_rules.summary: Mandates valid PSV licensing, police clearance (Good Conduct), commercial insurance, and official NTSA roadworthiness inspection certificates.

union_protocols.title: Union Representation & Independent Dispute Review
union_protocols.summary: TAWU members are entitled to formal union advocacy and independent manual review when automated algorithmic deactivations occur without human review.

platform_rules.title: Fraud Detection & Real-Time Photo Verification
platform_rules.summary: Outlines anti-fraud triggers including GPS route manipulation, account sharing, and real-time selfie check failures.

platform_rules.title: Service Suspension & Fare Dispute Resolution
platform_rules.summary: Governs fare recalculations, offline payment disputes, and suspension procedures for alleged policy violations.

platform_rules.title: Fare Integrity and System Discrepancies
platform_rules.summary: Regulates fare adjustments and requires M-Pesa or cash transaction receipts for trip verification.

platform_rules.title: Cash Reconciliation and PSV Maintenance
platform_rules.summary: Requires timely M-Pesa fare reconciliation and strict compliance with NTSA document renewals.

platform_rules.title: Document Expiration and Passenger Safety Audits
platform_rules.summary: Mandates immediate document re-upload upon expiry and formal review processes for rider safety flags.
